summary: Send the live SLO windows to the OpenTelemetry collector once a minute as gauges when [observations.otlp] is set

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change; the windows are process memory and a minute that cannot be delivered is dropped.

schema.detail: No table, index or migration change.

compatibility.detail: A daemon with [observations.otlp] sends six new metrics (st_slo_latency_ms, st_slo_over_target_ratio, st_slo_samples, st_slo_target_ms, st_slo_cpu_cores, st_slo_cpu_max_cores) to the collector's /v1/metrics once a minute. Daemons without [observations.otlp] and every existing signal are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Normal restart on deploy; the windows start empty after each restart.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure beyond the existing [observations.otlp].

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an older build stops the gauges; nothing is stored locally.
